fact: In September 2025 the Ministry of Information, Communications, Science, Technology and Innovation (MICSTI), with the Lesotho Institute of Public Administration and Management (LIPAM), held a one-day technology training session for public officers in Mohale's Hoek, and had engaged a consultancy to strengthen use of Microsoft Office 365 across government ministries and departments.
title: TIHELI URGES PUBLIC SERVANTS TO EMBRACE CHANGE
